Type: chair
Name: Phoenix Home Dining Chair, Single, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Wood
Dining chair with mid-century modern style; ideal for the dining room, living room, or general home or office use Single full-piece polypropylene plastic bucket seat molded for ergonomic comfort; matte black color Solid-wood and wire base provides strength, stability, and accenting color Non-marking feet protect floors from scratches; quick and easy to assemble Measures 21 by 18.5 by 32.5 inches (LxWxH); seat measures 17 by 18 by 17.5 inches (LxWxH)
